consequences: The frozen cross-mode semantic-checksum check (verifyCrossStageSemantics, operation-pipeline-report.mjs:826-835) refuses a candidate prepare cell measured in cpu and retained mode in ONE command, because checksum/iterations differs between a 5,000-iteration and a 500-iteration run. Within one mode every replicate is a fresh process and agrees, so the check passes there.
A driver or provider prepared-statement cache keys on SQL text. A monotonically increasing alias makes every repeated preparation of the same operation a distinct statement text.

The cutover does not touch the alias: cutover.patch changes client.ts, query-engine.ts, pending-operation.ts and route/client-route.ts and deletes legacy owners; the alias is emitted by src/query-engine/raptor3/shared/query.ts, which the patch does not modify. This is the routes own behaviour, first put in front of the benchmark here.
